summary: Added durable module and source-contract regressions for semantic LOD, bounded camera operations, capital-anchor identity, fixed-envelope district continuity, removal of synthetic project skill positions and project-only subsets, and camera-preserving employer-to-project selection. The exact targeted gate passes.

claims.claim: Project LOD requires project focus, and employer focus remains city LOD even at zoom 6.
constrainWorldCamera, cameraForPoint, zoomCameraAt, and panCameraByScreenDelta keep the full 1600x900 viewport inside the stage across extreme inputs.
Every employer has exactly one capital placement and that placement equals employer.anchor.
The renderer has no projectSkillPosition mapping; ArtInstance derives position from placement.position and uses kind-only fixed width and height envelopes.
One complete district remains mounted for every semantic non-world LOD, with exactly one ArtInstance render site and no second project-only asset subset.
Project selection from employer focus passes the current camera into applyFocus.
The tested implementation points are present in the production source.

deviations: The first exact gate attempt failed before test discovery because a concurrent pnpm command moved npm-installed direct dependencies into node_modules/.ignored. The responsible lane restored dependency resolution; the unchanged exact command was rerun and passed 12/12.

No DOM or browser fake was added. Pure camera, LOD, and placement behavior is exercised through the existing Vite module harness; renderer and hook wiring that is not exported is covered by bounded source contracts.
risks_blockers: A real browser interaction should still confirm that clicking a project while in employer focus preserves the rendered camera transform; this lane verifies the state source passes the camera but does not execute the React hook event path.
The fixed-envelope and one-district checks intentionally depend on stable implementation markers. A renderer refactor must update these source-contract tests or expose pure render-model helpers.
ledger_updates: No shared-ledger edit was made. Recommend recording TEST-1 as complete with the exact targeted gate passing 12/12 and retaining browser-level project-click continuity as a QA residual.
